Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, where a vehicle operated by Driver 1 was stopped in
traffic when the rear of the vehicle was struck by a vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 was identified at the scene
and is listed as the named insured on the applicable auto policy. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash,
a complaint that fits the forces involved in a collision of this type. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle at the
time and was confimred by responding officers and by sttaements from independent witnesses. Driver 2
acknolwedged the sequence of events as Driver 1 described them, and witnesses gave accounts consistent with that
version. Photographs taken at the scene show rear-end damage that corresponds to the reported point and direction
of impact. Driver 1 reported no prior damage to the vehicle, and none was observed by officers during the inspection.
No further unusual circumstances were noted, and the report is closed pending supplemental documentation.
